verdict.line: You lose if you get caught extended once she hits level 6 with Blade of the Exile active; you win if you kite her dash windows and never give her a clean Ki Burst engage.

brief.thesis: Gnar has the only ranged poke in this lane until Riven hits level 6, so the matchup is decided by whether he spends levels 1-5 whittling her down with Q (Boomerang Throw) from outside Q (Broken Wings)/E (Valor) range, or lets her close distance for free. Once she's 6 and running Blade of the Exile, her all-in burst briefly outscales a poke-based Gnar, which is exactly why the 48.6% win rate sits almost dead even despite his range edge.

theirWindow.when: she lands E then full Q combo
theirWindow.what: If Valor closes the gap and she chains all three Broken Wings hits into Ki Burst, she stuns and burns Runic Blade stacks for a big trade — disengage with Hop immediately rather than trading back.

yourWindow.when: her E and Q are both down
yourWindow.what: Valor (10/9/8/7/6s) and Broken Wings (13s) are her only gap closers; once both are spent without hitting you, she has no way to reach you — step up and land free Q (Boomerang Throw) and auto pokes.

powerCurve.note: ranged Q poke, she has no answer yet

start.why: Best-performing start into her (50% WR over 54 games, 65.1% pick) — the extra damage and sustain matter because early trades are auto-for-auto, not all-in.

boots.why: Overwhelming pick at 92.7% and the right call vs Riven's auto-attack-driven passive (Runic Blade) and her physical burst combo.

core.why: First item in every popular build path — the proc damage and move speed directly extend your kiting window.
Most-picked second item (16.7%) — shreds her armor so your poke keeps hurting as she itemizes.
Third item in two of the three listed paths — the HP and shield blunt exactly the burst window she gets post-6.

situational.when: her all-in is deleting you faster than you can kite away
she's fed and leaning on autoattacks through Runic Blade stacks
she's building into crit and one-shotting through your shield

runes.keystoneWhy: The most-picked page (31.7%, 52% WR) — the sustain and move speed proc keep you at poke range instead of in her Ki Burst radius. Master-tier Gnar players favor Lethal Tempo instead (1,803 games) when they plan to win extended trades through attack speed rather than disengage, which suits a more aggressive, ahead-on-items approach.

summoners.why: The most-picked and best-performing combo (65.8% pick, 51.9% WR) — Teleport lets you shove your ranged wave and still answer sidelane pressure, Flash covers her dash all-in. Exhaust+Flash (12.7% pick) actually posts the highest raw win rate at 40% if you want a lane-locked, all-in-denial setup instead.

playing.title: Kite before level 6
playing.detail: You have the only ranged tool in this lane until she hits Blade of the Exile. Bait her E (Valor) or Q (Broken Wings) on cooldown, then step up for free Q (Boomerang Throw) and autos.

playing.title: Count her Q charges
playing.detail: Broken Wings can reactivate up to three times in a short window, with the third hit knocking back. If she's burned all three without landing a hit, her engine is empty — that's your cue to extend the trade.

playing.title: Respect her level 6 spike
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile grants bonus AD, range, and a one-time ranged Wind Slash. Don't get caught extended past the minion wave the moment she hits 6 — this is the exact window OP.GG flags as dangerous.

playing.title: Save E for disengage, not engage
playing.detail: Hop (475 range, 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s cooldown) bounces off a unit for extra distance — use it to reset space after a Ki Burst stun rather than diving in, since Mega Gnar's version loses the bounce entirely and just smashes down in place.

playing.title: Punish the Ki Burst cooldown
playing.detail: Ki Burst (W) scales from 11s down to 7s cooldown. Once you've forced her to burn it early, step into melee range for a clean Q-plus-auto trade while it's down.

playing.title: Time your transformation
playing.detail: Rage builds through combat, so try to hit Mega Gnar right as she commits her combo — Mega Gnar's W becomes an area stun that can interrupt her Ki Burst or Q3 knockback instead of wasting the transform pushing wave.

playing.title: Itemize through the burst window
playing.detail: Trinity Force first for proc damage and kiting speed, Black Cleaver next to keep your poke relevant as she stacks armor, Sterak's Gage third specifically to survive her level 6-8 all-in spike.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the ability breakdowns, timing windows, and tactical reasoning connecting them are this brief's own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Kite her during early game to easily gain control over lane. Avoid being killed after she reaches level 6 and has Conqueror stacks.
